name: Cafe (Café) Dataset
description: Group activity detection (GAD) is the task of identifying members of each group and classifying the activity of the group at the same time in a video. While GAD has been studied recently, there is still much room for improvement in both dataset and methodology due to their limited capability to address practical GAD scenarios. To resolve these issues, we first present a new dataset, dubbed Caf\'e. Unlike existing datasets, Caf\'e is constructed primarily for GAD and presents more practical scenarios and metrics, as well as being large-scale and providing rich annotations. Along with the dataset, we propose a new GAD model that deals with an unknown number of groups and latent group members efficiently and effectively. We evaluated our model on three datasets including Caf\'e, where it outperformed previous work in terms of both accuracy and inference speed.
evaluation_method: task-dependent metrics (group identification: precision/recall/F1; activity classification: accuracy; detection: mAP)
general_score_metric: group activity classification accuracy / detection mAP (task-dependent)
reputation: Newer dataset (2023) designed specifically for group activity detection; of interest to the computer vision community but not yet a ubiquitous benchmark.
notes: Video-based, multi-person dataset — computationally intensive to train/evaluate. May have class imbalance and annotation biases; contains real-world scenes (privacy considerations). Not an LLM benchmark.
